gloss: right in half; in two equal pieces

definitions.gloss: right in half; in two equal pieces; clean in two
definitions.explanation: Split or divided into exactly two equal parts. Used literally for physical objects being cut or broken, and figuratively for opinions or groups being evenly divided.

examples.japanese: スイカを{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}った。
examples.english: I split the watermelon right in half.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}が{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{分|わ}かれた。
examples.english: Opinions were split right down the middle.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{大|おお}きな{木|き}が{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{折|お}れてしまった。
examples.english: A large tree was snapped clean in two by the typhoon.

notes:
USAGE:
The {真|ま}っ prefix intensifies {二|ふた}つ to emphasize an exact, clean split. Used both literally (cutting, breaking) and figuratively (divided opinions, split votes). Very vivid and expressive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{割|わ}る (split right in half)
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{折|お}れる (snap in two)
- {真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{分|わ}かれる (be divided right down the middle)
- {意見|いけん}が{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つ (opinions split 50-50)

GRAMMAR:
Can function as a noun (「{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つになる」) or adverbially with に (「{真|ま}っ{二|ふた}つに{切|き}る」).
